parsed.explanation: The averaging denominator is wrong: the listed 2^{n+1}-2 proper subset sums yield only 2^{n+1}-3 internal gaps, so they do not imply a gap at most 1/(2^{n+1}-1). Including the empty and full subsets gives 2^{n+1} sums in [0,1] and 2^{n+1}-1 gaps totaling 1. The later empty-side case already handles a gap involving an endpoint, so a local replacement of the pigeonhole sentence repairs the proof.
